entries.title: in-game pose grid
entries.positive: Retro 16-bit video game sprite sheet for a horizontal shooter, a regular grid of ten equal cells in two rows of five with even gutters, every cell showing the same small steel-blue dart-shaped fighter with a blue fuselage stripe, cyan canopy and orange engine glow in a strict side view facing right with only a thin sliver of the top of the hull visible, on a perfectly flat solid pure bright green chroma-key background. Top row, the five banking frames from left to right: steep climb with the nose tilted up and the upper wing foreshortened, slight climb, level flight, slight dive, steep dive with the nose tilted down and the lower wing foreshortened. Bottom row, the level-flight hull: the first four cells are a smoothly looping four-frame engine thruster animation from left to right (short flame, medium flame, long two-tone orange flame, medium flickering flame that loops back to the first), and the fifth cell is a full-boost reference with a long white-hot core streak. Every sprite drawn as crisp pixel art with a 1-pixel near-black navy outline at its native pixel scale, flat saturated fills with three-step shading ramps lit from the top-left, identical scale, position and silhouette in every cell, no anti-aliasing, no drop shadows, no glow bleeding onto the background, no text, no numbers, no cell borders, arcade sprite art.

entries.title: in-game pose grid
entries.positive: Retro 16-bit video game sprite sheet for a horizontal shooter, a regular grid of ten equal cells in two rows of five with even gutters, every cell showing the same flat pale-mint manta-ray-shaped starfighter with a small green canopy, amber twin thrusters and a heavy near-black green outline in side view facing right, on a perfectly flat solid pure bright green chroma-key background. Top row, the five banking frames from left to right: steep climb with the nose and the leading wing edge tilted up, slight climb, level glide, slight dive, steep dive with the nose tilted down. Bottom row, the level-glide hull with five thruster states from left to right: idle with two short amber embers, small twin flames, medium twin flames, long red-amber twin plumes, and full boost with white-hot cores in both plumes. Every sprite drawn as crisp pixel art with a 1-pixel near-black green outline at its native pixel scale, flat saturated fills with three-step shading lit from the top-left, identical scale, position and silhouette in every cell, no anti-aliasing, no drop shadows, no glow bleeding onto the background, no text, no numbers, no cell borders, arcade sprite art.
